package.description: Identify yourself or use digital signatures with thousands of companies and authorities.

en-US.description: Identify yourself or use digital signatures with thousands of companies and authorities.
en-US.longDescription:
BankID is a common way to identify yourself in digital environments. You do not have to create accounts with passwords with different actors, and can instead use the same secure solution for everyone. Like showing your ID, but digitally.
You can use BankID for identification or digital signatures with thousands of companies and authorities. You can also activate a digital ID card in your BankID app.
ONLY valid for Swedish BankID. Does NOT work for Norwegian BankID.
en-US.name: BankID säkerhetsprogram

zh-CN.description: 在数千家企业和政府机构中进行身份验证或使用数字签名。
zh-CN.longDescription:
BankID 是数字环境中常用的身份验证方式。您无需为不同机构创建带密码的账户，只需使用这一通用安全解决方案即可。就像出示身份证件一样，只不过是以数字形式实现。
您可以通过 BankID 与数千家企业和政府机构进行身份认证或数字签名。还可在 BankID 应用中激活电子身份证功能。
